versions.changelog:
- Initial release of sustoiclab-methodic-doubt: a Descartes-inspired argument deconstruction and premise-questioning coach.
- Supports Chinese trigger keywords related to methodic doubt, "Cogito ergo sum", and clear and distinct perception.
- Guides users step-by-step to question assumptions behind any viewpoint, decision, or debate.
- Follows the logic chain of Descartes' "Meditations on First Philosophy" with focus on methodic skepticism and premise analysis.
- Provides one guiding question at a time to help identify core, indubitable beliefs—never giving conclusions for the user.
